Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us. The Purpose PPRO’s Digital Workplace team strives to enable every employee to do their best work. We aim to provide a delightful, innovative, and secure IT experience. Our Colleague Support Engineers are at the forefront of that effort, assisting our colleagues with their IT needs, challenges, and issues throughout their journey with PPRO. We treat every colleague as a customer and aim for an exceptional experience every time they ask us for help. In our vibrant São Paulo office, you'll be one of two IT ambassadors on the ground, working alongside another Colleague IT Support Engineer. From resolving critical login issues to optimising office connectivity for the whole team, you'll be the trusted expert your colleagues rely on every day. In addition to owning end-to-end first and second line support locally, you'll support colleagues across the whole business and in every PPRO office. You'll work closely with our support teams in London, Munich, and Berlin to drive consistent, high-quality standards across all PPRO locations. You'll play a key role in fostering a supportive, solution-driven workplace culture. Your Impact In This Role Deliver exceptional first and second line IT support to colleagues across the whole business and every PPRO office, while collaborating on global support initiatives Give every colleague an exceptional customer experience, keeping each interaction clear, friendly, and helpful, and using feedback to keep improving the service Together with your fellow Colleague IT Support Engineer, be the main IT contact for everyone in our São Paulo office, fixing issues quickly so colleagues can get on with their work Administer access management via Okta and Terraform to ensure secure, seamless employee onboarding and daily operations Manage the full macOS and Windows device lifecycle, ensuring endpoints are secure, up to date, and performing optimally Drive innovation by introducing modern AI productivity tools, such as Claude, to help team members optimise daily workflows Champion the IT employee lifecycle, driving memorable onboarding experiences for new starters and smooth offboardings Optimise office network connectivity and audiovisual hardware across meeting rooms and workstations to enable effortless collaboration Author and refine knowledge base documentation, encouraging self-service problem solving across the organisation Partner with vendor networks to streamline local hardware procurement, software licensing, and repair management What Would Make You a Great Fit Proven track record in IT support, with equivalent practical experience or a relevant degree 3+ years of experience resolving complex technical issues in dynamic environments Ability to work in our São Paulo office five days a week (must be based in Brazil with the right to work there) Very strong spoken and written English, as you'll support colleagues across all our offices Fluent Portuguese Solid background supporting enterprise macOS and Windows operating systems Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Intune, Jira, or Workspace ONE Experience managing IT support ticketing systems, such as Jira Service Management Nice To Have Prior experience in customer-centric roles or technical support desks Experience with M365 and Dynamics What's in it for you? Holiday: 30-day holiday allowance per year. Learning and Development - We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role. Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance + dental plan and travel insurance. Meal vouchers - BRL 54/ day - Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good and balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two). Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments. Transportation Voucher - we will cover your costs of commute! Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet. New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) - Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events. Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more. SESC - private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents. Pet-friendly office- Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side. Our Principles We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done. We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do. We make things better: We boldly explore new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement. We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement. Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion Payments only work when they reflect how different people actually pay, and we build teams the same way: our people span more than 50 nationalities, and that mix is exactly what makes us good at this. So if you're reading this and wondering whether you tick every box, apply anyway. We're far more interested in what you'll bring than a perfect match on paper. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and experience, and we make sure our hiring process is accessible to everyone. If you need an adjustment at any stage, just let us know: we're happy to help. A Few More Things We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy .

review_candidates.description: Senior Business Systems Analyst / Blue Yonder WMS Solution Architect Location: Columbus, OH or Atlanta, GA JOB SUMMARY This role combines the analytical depth of a Senior Business Systems Analyst with the hands-on expertise of a WMS Consultant and the strategic vision of a Solution Architect. It focuses on the advanced configuration, optimization, and ongoing support of the Blue Yonder Warehouse Management System (WMS), ensuring it meets the organization’s logistics, warehousing, and supply chain objectives. This senior role is essential for analyzing business needs, implementing Blue Yonder solutions, and architecting scalable WMS solutions to streamline operations, enhance productivity, and support the company’s growth. As a senior team member, you will guide the strategy and execution of critical projects, mentor junior team members, and ensure our solutions remain forward-thinking and aligned with evolving business needs. You will work closely with our clients, operational sites, and user community to ensure we provide the best possible solution and support. RESPONSIBILITIES: Business Analysis & Solution Design: Lead in-depth analysis of complex warehousing, distribution, and logistics requirements, translating these needs into detailed functional specifications and systems design for the Blue Yonder WMS. Collaborate with key stakeholders to define project requirements, identify system capabilities, and document business processes that can be enhanced through the WMS. Design and architect scalable Blue Yonder WMS configurations and solutions that align with long-term company goals, ensuring scalability and adherence to industry best practices. System Implementation & Configuration: Lead the implementation and customization of the Blue Yonder WMS, including setup, configuration, and testing, ensuring alignment with long-term business goals and operational efficiency. Oversee and participate in integration efforts between Blue Yonder WMS and other key systems, including ERP, TMS (Transportation Management Systems), and order management systems, ensuring seamless data flow between systems. Customize and fine-tune Blue Yonder modules and configurations to align with business workflows and optimize for efficiency, accuracy, and speed. Solution Architecture & System Optimization: Design and implement advanced system solutions that improve warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, and productivity, with an emphasis on long-term scalability and performance. Architect and implement advanced WMS features, automation, and innovations to streamline warehouse operations, inventory management, order management, and reverse logistics. Continuously assess and adjust the system architecture to ensure it meets future business needs and integrates seamlessly with evolving technology solutions. Support & Continuous Improvement: Lead post-implementation support, troubleshooting, and optimization efforts to ensure sustained system performance, user satisfaction, and ongoing business process improvement. Identify, recommend, and implement strategic enhancements to the WMS to drive long-term operational efficiencies and cost reductions. Act as a senior subject matter expert (SME) on the Blue Yonder WMS, providing thought leadership and guidance on best practices, new features, and system innovations. Training & Documentation: Mentor and train junior analysts and operational teams, ensuring proficiency in the use and administration of the Blue Yonder WMS. Create and maintain comprehensive technical and user documentation, including training materials, system configurations, process flows, and system architecture diagrams. Lead knowledge transfer sessions to internal teams, empowering them with the expertise required for troubleshooting and system maintenance at a high level. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a bridge between IT, operations, and external vendors to align WMS configurations with broader business strategies. Drive and lead cross-functional teams through strategic initiatives, ensuring the alignment of WMS solutions with organizational goals. Conduct periodic reviews and strategic planning sessions with stakeholders to assess performance, gather feedback, and identify areas for system or process improvements. EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in any of the following: Computer/Software Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field EXPERIENCE: Minimum of 5-8 years of experience with Blue Yonder WMS or similar warehouse management systems, including implementation and configuration. Proven experience with business systems analysis, solution design, and/or solution architecture within the supply chain or logistics environment. Demonstrated leadership experience in cross-functional project management and business process analysis, including the ability to mentor junior analysts and lead teams in successful project delivery. Experience working with senior leadership and stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives and align system implementations with business goals. Experience in industries such as 3PL, retail, e-commerce, or manufacturing is preferred. Experience with Azure, Power BI, or other data analysis and reporting tools is an asset. TECHNICAL SKILLS: In-depth knowledge of Blue Yonder WMS modules, including inventory control, order fulfillment, picking/packing, shipping, and receiving. Advanced knowledge of integration protocols and tools, including API, EDI, and SQL for data management and reporting. Proficiency with Blue Yonder configuration tools, business logic, and system architecture for customizing solutions. CORE COMPETENCIES: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments and with non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a high attention to detail. Ability to manage and lead high-impact projects from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Strong ability to mentor, guide, and develop junior team members and contribute to their professional growth. Willingness and ability to travel as needed domestic and internationally Export Control Requirements This position requires access to technical data, technology, or defense articles subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). The successful candidate must be eligible to access these items in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, including through any required U.S. government authorization. Employment in this role is contingent upon verification of applicable export-control access requirements.
